collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

the draft's effect, never shown: the outcome's effect

collection.description: An elder's sore knees do not hurt at all today: take a long walk, or enjoy it quietly.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1)'s knees have bothered (him/her) for years. Some days are bad; some are less bad. Today, for no reason at all, they don't hurt. Not even a twinge. (name1) has walked to the stream and back without thinking about it. (He/she) is standing in the sunshine, testing them, slightly suspicious.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) doesn't do anything special. (He/she) just goes about the day and enjoys the not-hurting. Getting up. Sitting down. Climbing the step into the hut. All of it easy. It's a lovely, ordinary day. Tomorrow the knees will probably be back to normal. Today they aren't, and (name1) notices every moment of it.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (name1) decides not to waste it. (He/she) walks all the way to the far end of the beach, past the rocks, to a little cove (he/she) hasn't visited in years. It's just as (he/she) remembered. (He/she) sits there for an hour. (His/her) knees are sore again by the time (he/she) gets home. (He/she) doesn't regret a step.
